lines.en: I tap on Rika’s name in my phone after remembering that she told me to call just several hours before I took Nodoka’s virginity.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Rika 的名字——因为我记得,就在我夺走 Nodoka 初夜的几个小时前,她叮嘱过我打电话。

lines.en: Does that technically relate to Rika in any way? No. But I can’t help but correlate certain things when they happen in pairs.
lines.zh: : 严格来说,这和 Rika 有一丁点关系吗?没有。但成对发生的事,我总忍不住去建立关联。

lines.en: Because, according to that butterfly thing, it’s possible I never would have had sex with Nodoka at all if Rika hadn’t given me her number. I think.
lines.zh: : 因为按照那个蝴蝶什么的,要是 Rika 没把电话号码塞给我,我可能根本不会和 Nodoka 上床。我觉得。

lines.en: I don’t know. I’m probably fucking up the butterfly thing since I can’t even remember what it’s called right now, but I’m sure there’s someone out there who knows what I’m talking about.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我多半把蝴蝶理论搞砸了——因为我连它叫什么都想不起来。但我确信世上有个人明白我在说什么。

lines.en: And hey, maybe that person is Rika? She’s certainly wise beyond her years.
lines.zh: : 说不定那个人就是 Rika?她绝对岁数不大、智慧超群。

lines.en: : Hey! Good timing. How fast do you think you need to run in order to dodge the rain?
lines.zh: : 嘿!来得正好。你觉得人要跑多快,才能躲开雨?

lines.en: I was being facetious, if you couldn’t tell.
lines.zh: : 如果你听不出来——刚才是玩笑。

lines.en: : Why? You’re not planning on trying, are you?
lines.zh: : 为什么?你不是打算试吧?

lines.en: : I’m in an argument with Rin and Futaba. They say it’s not possible but I am going to prove them wrong.
lines.zh: : 我正在和 Rin、Futaba 争论。她们说不可能有这种速度,但我要证明她们错了。

lines.en: : They’re right and you’re smarter than this.
lines.zh: : 她们是对的,你也比这聪明。

lines.en: : Fuck.
: Anyway, what’s up? You don’t usually call me.
lines.zh: : 话说,怎么了?你平时不给我打电话。

lines.en: : That’s because I didn’t have your number until you desperately thrust it upon me in an effort to counteract your loneliness. But seeing as you’re already busy arguing with Rin and Futaba-
lines.zh: : 那是因为直到你为了排解孤独、拼命把号码塞给我之前,我都没有你的号码。不过既然你正忙着和 Rin、Futaba 争论——

lines.en: : You can come argue with me! I need someone on my side!
lines.zh: : 你可以来跟我吵!我需要有人站我这边!

lines.en: : Well, I don’t believe in your cause, but I’m a pretty good liar when I want to be. So I guess I can swing by.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我不信你的歪理,但只要我想,我可是个相当不错的演员。所以我顺便过去一趟。

lines.en: : Are you in your room? Or rather, are you still squatting in Rin’s room?
lines.zh: : 你在自己房间?还是说,你还赖在 Rin 的房间里?

lines.en: : I am at the gym! All three of us are. That writer girl was supposed to come as well, but she started ranting about some shit I didn’t understand and then ran away.
lines.zh: : 我在健身房!我们仨都在。那个写东西的女孩本来也要来,但她开始 rant 一些我听不懂的鬼东西,然后跑掉了。

lines.en: : Yeah, that sounds about right. Only thing is, if you’re at the gym, there’s someone I need to talk to first in order to make sure I’m not yelled at again.
lines.zh: : 嗯,听起来很有道理。只是,你们既然在健身房,我得先跟某个人通个气,免得再被吼一次。

lines.en: : Relatable. I’ve been banned from several public spaces as well, but that was mostly cause of protests and stuff. Need me to find the manager?
lines.zh: : 懂。我也被好几个公共场所禁入过,不过多半是因为抗议什么的。需要我帮你找管理员吗?

lines.en: : No, just put Futaba on.
lines.zh: : 不用,让 Futaba 接电话。

lines.en: : Futaba manages the gym? What the fuck?
lines.zh: : Futaba 管健身房?什么鬼?

lines.en: : Just put her on, Rika.
lines.zh: : 让她接,Rika。

lines.en: : Futaba! Phone!
lines.zh: : Futaba!电话!

lines.en: : Huh? What? For me? Why?
lines.zh: : 嗯?什么?找我?为什么?

lines.en: : Uhh...hello?
: Hey.
: Sensei? Why are you calling Rin’s mom? And...why are you asking for me?
lines.zh: : Sensei?你为什么打给 Rin 的妈妈?而且……为什么找我要?

lines.en: : So that I don’t further breach any sort of agreement we had regarding me not showing up at the gym while you’re there.
lines.zh: : 为了不进一步违反我们之间的协议——就是你不去健身房时我也不出现在那里的那份。

lines.en: : Heh...thank you for the warning this time.
lines.zh: : 呵……谢谢你这次提前打招呼。

lines.en: : It’s fine. You can come. I just won’t have much time to spend with you if you do, but...considering you called Rika, I’m...pretty sure she’s the one who...
lines.zh: : 没事。你可以来。只是你来了我也没多少时间陪你……不过,考虑到你打给了 Rika,我……很确定,她才是那个……

lines.en: : A-Anyway! I...I’ll see you soon! Bye!
lines.zh: : 总、总之!我……马上见!拜!

lines.en: Instead of handing the phone back to Rika, Futaba hangs up. And even though I’m not there, I can tell she immediately regrets it.
lines.zh: Futaba 没有把手机递回给 Rika,而是直接挂断了。虽然我不在场,我也能断定她立刻就后悔了。

lines.en: Regardless, I set off toward the gym after quickly refreshing my memory on where it’s located.
lines.zh: : 无论如何,我快速回忆了一下健身房的位置,然后动身出发。

lines.en: Halfway there, I realize why Rika and the others were arguing about rain.
lines.zh: : 走到一半,我明白了 Rika 她们在争论雨的什么。

lines.en: Call it a lack of willpower or a heavy dose of self-doubt, but I don’t test her theory about dodging anything, electing to simply let myself get drenched instead.
lines.zh: : 也许是意志力薄弱,也许是自我怀疑过量,我没有去验证她「跑得够快就能躲雨」的理论,而是干脆选择让自己淋成落汤鸡。

lines.en: Which, based on everyone’s reactions, seems like it was the wrong idea.
lines.zh: : 而从大家的反应来看,这显然是个错误的决定。

lines.en: : What the heck?! No one told me there was a pool here!
lines.zh: : 搞什么?!没人告诉我这里有个泳池!

lines.en: : Do you not believe in umbrellas? Or are you just really out of shape?
lines.zh: : 你不信世上有伞这种东西吗?还是说你体型彻底垮了?

lines.en: : I can...get you a towel if you want?
lines.zh: : 我可以……给你拿条毛巾?

lines.en: : No, I’ll just suffer. What’s going on? How are things?
lines.zh: : 不用,我就这么受着吧。怎么了?最近怎么样?

lines.en: : Dry.
lines.zh: : 干的。

lines.en: : Great! Just enjoying some overdue quality time with my daughter and her best friend!
lines.zh: : 太好了!我正和我女儿还有她最好的朋友,享受迟到的天伦之乐!

lines.en: : Yes. Overdue. As if she does not literally sleep in my bed.
lines.zh: : 是,「迟到」。说得好像她不是真的天天睡我床上似的。

lines.en: : I slept in Futaba’s once too. But it wasn’t intentional and I’m not a predator. I was just really drunk.
lines.zh: : 我也睡过 Futaba 的床。但那不是故意的,我也不是捕食者。我只是喝得烂醉。

lines.en: : Good excuse, but I doubt that would hold up in court.
lines.zh: : 借口不错,但我怀疑法庭上站不住脚。

lines.en: : Sensei, I know the separation has a lot to do with it, but it’s really not a good look that my mom developed a drinking problem as soon as she started hanging out with you.
lines.zh: : Sensei,我知道分开住有很大关系,但我妈妈一和你混到一起就染上酒瘾,这实在是不好看。

lines.en: : If anything, it’s miraculous that the rest of you haven’t.
lines.zh: : 真要说,你们其他人没染上,才是奇迹。

lines.en: : I’m sure that being unable to actually buy alcohol is...a big part of it.
lines.zh: : 我确信,「买不到酒」这一点……占了很大比重。

lines.en: : You come here often, Sensei? I can use a new gym buddy for when Rin is fed up with me. Which is pretty much all the time now.
lines.zh: : 你常来这边吗,Sensei?Rin 嫌弃我的时候,我需要一个新健身搭子。而这基本上是她现在的常态。

lines.en: : Just come with Nodoka when she’s not busy running away. I don’t like places like this.
lines.zh: : 等她不忙逃跑的时候,带着 Nodoka 一起来。我不喜欢这种地方。

lines.en: : Really? How do you stay in shape, then?
lines.zh: : 真的吗?那你怎么保持身材的?

lines.en: : I have an idea.
lines.zh: : 我有个主意。

lines.en: : I...don’t. Hahah...hah...
lines.zh: : 我……不保持。哈哈……哈……

lines.en: : Why do they sound like they’re hiding something from me? Are you, like...secretly a ballet dancer or something?
lines.zh: : 你们俩怎么听着像在瞒我什么事?你是不是……偷偷是个芭蕾舞演员什么的?

lines.en: : Why is that your first assumption? That’s weird.
lines.zh: : 你为什么第一反应是那个?好怪。

lines.en: : I don’t know. Your limbs are long and I think you’d look good in tights. Is that weird too?
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。你四肢修长,我觉得你穿紧身衣肯定好看。这也很怪吗?

lines.en: : Yes, Mom. It is.
lines.zh: : 是的,妈妈。很怪。

lines.en: : Honestly, though? I agree. And I kind of want to see that now.
lines.zh: : 不过说实话?我同意。而且我现在有点想看了。

lines.en: : I...also wouldn’t mind...
lines.zh: : 我……也不介意……

lines.en: : I brought an extra pair of leggings you can try on if you want? Might have to tuck it in if you know what I’m saying, though.
lines.zh: : 我多带了一条打底裤,你要不要试试?不过你可能得把「它」塞进去,你懂我意思。

lines.en: : I know what-
lines.zh: : 我知道那是什——

lines.en: : It means your dick.
lines.zh: : 就是指你的那根。

lines.en: : I'm saying you'd have to tuck your dick in so you don't get arrested for indecent exposure.
lines.zh: : 我是说,你得把那根塞好,不然你会因为「有伤风化」被抓。

lines.en: : That's a real charge, you know. And don't worry, I thought it sounded fake too.
lines.zh: : 那可是真实存在的罪名哦。别担心,我刚听到时也觉得很假。

lines.en: : Oh, would you look at the time? I just remembered I have things to do today. Things that don’t involve wearing women’s clothes or exposing my penis in a gym.
lines.zh: : 哦,瞧瞧几点了。我突然想起今天还有事。一些不涉及穿女装、也不涉及在健身房里亮出我的 penis 的事。

lines.en: : Want me to walk you out? I was about to go get some fresh air anyway.
lines.zh: : 要我送你出去吗?我正好也想去透口气。

lines.en: : I was actually just being sarcastic about leaving, but sure. I’ll go outside with you. Futaba doesn’t like when I watch her anyway and she makes it hard for me to not stare at her in places like this.
lines.zh: : 我刚才说要走其实就是句反话,不过行。我陪你出去。反正 Futaba 不喜欢我盯着她看,而在这种地方,想不盯她都难。

lines.en: : Mood.
: Th...That’s not my fault! If I could make them smaller, I would!
lines.zh: : 那……那不是我的错!我要是能把它们变小,我早就变了!

lines.en: : You look great just the way you are, Futaba! Never feel pressured to change! But know that I would completely understand if you did anyway because your back is fucked when you get older.
lines.zh: : Futaba,你现在这样就很好!永远不要因为压力改变自己!不过我也完全理解,如果你真想变——毕竟等你上了年纪,你的背会被压垮的。

lines.en: : Was that...supposed to be encouraging?
lines.zh: : 这话……算是鼓励吗?

lines.en: : Ready? We can stop in the lounge along the way and grab you a towel so you can dry off.
lines.zh: : 准备好了吗?路上可以在休息室停一下,给你拿条毛巾擦擦。

lines.en: : Before going right back into the rain? Great idea.
lines.zh: : 然后再一头扎回雨里?好主意。

lines.en: : There’s, like...a thingy. A thingy we can stand under. A rain-blocking thingy.
lines.zh: : 有一个……东西。一个我们能站着躲雨的东西。一个挡雨的东西。

lines.en: : You mean an “awning?”
lines.zh: : 你是说「雨棚」?

lines.en: : Yeah. A rain-blocking thingy.
lines.zh: : 对。一个挡雨的东西。

lines.en: : Rin, stop staring at me.
lines.zh: : Rin,别盯着我看。

lines.en: : I can’t. My eyes are all locked up from all the...eye exercise I’ve been doing.
lines.zh: : 我停不下来。我的眼睛因为做太多……眼部锻炼,全锁死了。

lines.en: : Eyexercise.
lines.zh: : 「眼锻炼」。

lines.en: : Weren’t you leaving?!
lines.zh: : 你不是要走吗?!

lines.en: Rika and I head across the hall so I can make myself look slightly presentable and stop tracking water everywhere I go.
lines.zh: Rika 和我穿过大厅,好让我把仪容收拾得稍微体面些、别再一路滴水。

lines.en: She takes it upon herself to dry my back once I’m done with my hair and, while I wasn’t expecting this and would have likely rejected it if I knew it was coming, it’s...fine, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我弄完头发后,她自作主张替我擦背;虽然我完全没料到、要是知道多半会拒绝,但……还行吧,我猜。

lines.en: It’s not like she’s doing it because she wants to fuck me. Even if she probably would fuck me. I think.
lines.zh: : 这又不是因为她想睡我。即便她八成愿意睡我。我觉得。

lines.en: I’m not sure.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。

lines.en: But I guess trying to find out right now would ruin the mood.
lines.zh: : 但我猜,现在就弄清楚的话,会破坏气氛。

lines.en: I should be happy to just...spend some time with someone like her — who won’t just not judge me for things, but is likely incapable of judging me for anything in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我应该庆幸,能和一个她这样的人共度时光——她不仅不会因为这些事评判我,恐怕压根就没有评判任何人的能力。

lines.en: Whether that’s due to blissful, forced ignorance or her head being completely empty is another question entirely.
lines.zh: : 至于这是因为幸福的无知、被动的蒙蔽,还是因为她的脑袋彻底空空,那就是另一个问题了。

lines.en: But this is the part of the conversation where I probe her for background information, so I will leave any prior thoughts at the door (Just like an umbrella) and forge forward without them.
lines.zh: : 但对话进行到这里,就该轮到我打探她的背景了,所以我把之前的念头都留在门口(就像留伞那样),不带偏见地向前推进。

lines.en: : Motherhood. Am I right?
lines.zh: : 为母之道。我说的对吧?

lines.en: I come out swinging with another flawless attempt to appear human.
lines.zh: : 我一出手,又是一次完美 attempts 扮演人类的尝试。

lines.en: : It has its ups and downs. Mostly ups. But then your daughter decides she’s too cool for you and that you’d be better off wandering aimlessly through the country with all of your belongings in a shopping cart.
lines.zh: : 有起有落。多半是起。但随后你的女儿会决定你配不上她,而你不如推着购物车、装上全部家当,在全国漫无目的地流浪。

lines.en: : I’ve already lived that life, man. I’m not ready to go back.
lines.zh: : 那种日子我已经过过了,伙计。我没准备好回去。

lines.en: : Based on what little information I’ve gotten out of you, it seems like your past is full of...odd things like that. So I won’t pretend to be surprised right now.
lines.zh: : 从你嘴里挤出的那点信息来看,你的过去似乎充满了……这类古怪的事。所以我就不假装惊讶了。

lines.en: : What can I say? I’m pretty cool, aren’t I? Rin should be happy she has a mom with so much life experience.
lines.zh: : 我能说什么呢?我挺酷的,不是吗?Rin 应该庆幸,她有一个人生阅历这么丰富的妈妈。

lines.en: : But instead, she just yells at me for embarrassing her. Life is pain.
lines.zh: : 可她回报我的方式,是冲我吼,说我让她丢人。人生即苦痛。

lines.en: : It is. But that doesn’t mean she isn’t happy to have you. I heard nothing but good things prior to you showing up and confirming your existence.
lines.zh: : 是苦。但这不代表她有你不好。在你出现、确认真实存在之前,我听到的全是关于你的好话。

lines.en: : Really? Like what?
lines.zh: : 真的吗?比如?

lines.en: : Okay, so I didn’t really hear much at all. But you can go ahead and pretend I said a bunch of really flattering things right here if that makes you happy.
lines.zh: : 好吧,其实我什么都没听到多少。不过你可以尽管想象,我在这里说了一堆特别动听的话,只要那能让你开心。

lines.en: : Hah...figures. I’m sure that even if she said anything good, it would have been about her other mom. She was always closer to her than she was to me. The pain continues.
lines.zh: : 哈……我就知道。我敢肯定,就算她说过什么好话,说的也是她另一位妈妈。她一直更亲近那位,不是我。痛苦仍在继续。

lines.en: : She still likes you. I obviously haven’t been around her as much as you, but the way she treats you is unlike how she is with literally everyone else.
lines.zh: : 她还是喜欢你的。显然我不像你那样常陪着她,但她对你的方式,和她对待其他任何一个人都不一样。

lines.en: : I know. I’m just being a pain.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我就是找茬。

lines.en: : I never had a great relationship with my mom and she wound up passing away before I was able to, like...see eye-to-eye with her and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我和我妈的关系从来就不好,而她还没等到我……和她真正交心什么的,就走了。

lines.en: : So I’ve always tried to stay on good terms with Rin to avoid something like that. Cause, you know...in twenty years when I’m dead, I’m sure she’ll be happy I crashed in her dorm room for a couple months.
lines.zh: : 所以我一直努力和 Rin 保持好的关系,避免重蹈覆辙。因为,你知道的……二十年后我死了,她多半会庆幸,我曾经在她宿舍里赖过几个月。

lines.en: : I...don’t know if I’d go that far or...word things exactly like that. But I do know she appreciates you.
lines.zh: : 我……不觉得事情有那么夸张,或者……措辞会完全那样。但我确实知道,她感激你。

lines.en: : So, I’m not embarrassing?
lines.zh: : 所以,我不丢人?

lines.en: : No, you definitely are.
lines.zh: : 不,你绝对挺丢人的。

lines.en: : Frick.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。

lines.en: : Being embarrassing isn’t necessarily a bad thing, though. And I’m sure she’d take that over rotting in an orphanage somewhere.
lines.zh: : 不过丢人不一定就是坏事。而且我确信,比起烂在某个孤儿院里,她宁可选丢人的你。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: You know, I’ve been with her for so long that I forget she’s adopted and not just a lesbian miracle-baby sometimes.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,我和她相处太久,有时候都会忘了她是领养的,而不是什么女同志的奇迹宝宝。

lines.en: : Just...thinking about her in a place like that gives me the creeps. I seriously couldn’t have asked for a better daughter.
lines.zh: : 一想到她可能在那种地方,我就发毛。我真的不可能再要求一个更好的女儿了。

lines.en: : Wasn’t without its hardships, though. And even if she’s come to accept it as normal now, it wasn’t always like that.
lines.zh: : 不过也不是没有艰辛。就算她现在已经把一切当成正常,以前也不总是这样。

lines.en: : Which I guess is part of the reason she gravitated to my partner instead of me since she was the one who was good at explaining all that kind of stuff. I didn’t really know what I was doing.
lines.zh: : 我猜,这也是她更亲近我的伴侣、而不是我的部分原因——因为擅长解释那些事的,是她。我真的不知道自己在做什么。

lines.en: : To be honest, I never really even thought of being a mom when I was younger. Life just kind of worked out that way.
lines.zh: : 说实话,我年轻的时候从来没想过当妈。人生就这样安排下来了。

lines.en: : Was it your partner who decided to adopt then?
lines.zh: : 是你的伴侣决定领养的吗?

lines.en: : I mean, that’s not really a decision someone can make on their own. There are a lot of steps involved and I knew it was coming. I didn’t just come home one day and...boom, child. I knew and I helped.
lines.zh: : 呃,这种事不是一个人能拍板的。流程很多,而且我知道会有这么一天。我不是某天回家就……砰,多了个孩子。我知道,我也出了力。

lines.en: : It just wasn’t my idea.
lines.zh: : 只是,那不是我的主意。

lines.en: : Just kinda sucks it had to come to that in the first place. And I can’t help but think about how all of the kids we didn’t choose wound up.
lines.zh: : 只可惜,事情最后走到了那一步。而我总会忍不住去想:那些我们没有选中的孩子,后来怎么样了。

lines.en: : As someone who has never and will never adopt, I’m sure that line of thinking isn’t exactly abnormal. I’d probably be caught up in the same thoughts in your position.
lines.zh: : 作为一个从未领养过、也永远不会领养的人,我确信这种想法再正常不过。换成是我,多半也会被同样的念头缠住。

lines.en: : Which, again, is not a position I will ever be in as I hate children.
lines.zh: : 再强调一遍,我永远不会有这种处境——因为我讨厌小孩。

lines.en: : If it helps persuade you at all, Rin was far from an average kid. But I totally get that adoption isn’t for everyone when people like you can, like...go out and just recreationally make babies and shit.
lines.zh: : 如果这能稍微说服你:Rin 远远不是普通的孩子。但我完全理解,领养这件事不适合每个人——毕竟像你这样的人,可以……随便出门、消遣式地造孩子什么的。

lines.en: : Just, whatever you do, don’t go on some crazy impregnation spree or something. Orphanages are crowded enough as-is and the last thing we need is more kids with no place to call home.
lines.zh: : 只是,不管你干什么,千万别搞什么疯狂的播种狂欢。孤儿院本来就挤,我们最不需要的就是更多无家可归的孩子。

lines.en: : Or even worse, a place to call home but, like...not a good place. Because while I did a decently bang-up job as a mom in hindsight, same thing can’t be said for everyone.
lines.zh: : 或者更糟,有家可归,但……不是什么好家。因为虽然事后诸葛地讲,我这个妈妈当得还算凑合,但不是每个人都当得好。

lines.en: : Which one of those two was Rin? Someone with no home or someone with a shitty one?
lines.zh: : 这两种,Rin 是哪一种?无家可归的那种,还是家里很糟的那种?

lines.en: : I want to say that’s something you should talk to her about, but I’m not really sure how much she even remembers. So I’ll just tell you what I know.
lines.zh: : 我想说这话你应该去和她聊,但我不确定她还记得多少。所以我只告诉你我知道的。

lines.en: : Her bio-mom was a fucking psycho.
lines.zh: : 她的生母是个该死的精神病。

lines.en: : I don’t think she was ever, like...abusive or anything like that, but the girl was straight up deranged. Like, genuinely insane.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得她……虐待过她什么的,但那姑娘是彻头彻尾的疯癫。真的,不折不扣的精神失常。

lines.en: : The case-worker explained the situation in much greater detail way back when we adopted her and I don’t remember everything, but...
lines.zh: : 领养的时候,社工把情况讲得详细得多,我已经记不全了,但是……

lines.en: : I do remember she was way too young to be having a kid. And that she had, like...intense brain trauma or some shit. Just straight up the exact type of person who can’t raise a little girl alone.
lines.zh: : 我记得她年纪太小,根本不适合生孩子。而且她好像……有严重的脑创伤之类的鬼东西。就是那种绝不可能独自抚养小女孩的类型。

lines.en: : Alone? So her father was never in the picture either?
lines.zh: : 「独自」?所以她父亲也从没出现过?

lines.en: : Nah. Douchebag ran off before she was even born. Wouldn’t be surprised if he already had a family or something like that. Even the case-worker didn’t know what his deal was.
lines.zh: : 没有。人渣在她出生前就跑了。他要是已经另立家庭什么的,我也不会意外。连社工都搞不清他的底细。

lines.en: : Sure didn’t help that Rin’s bio-mom wasn’t exactly in the state to open up about him either.
lines.zh: : 更糟的是,Rin 的生母当时的状态,也不太可能开口讲他的事。

lines.en: : But, hey- that’s one more reason you shouldn’t go around making babies you aren’t ready to take care of.
lines.zh: : 不过,嘿——这也是又一条理由:别到处造你根本无力照顾的孩子。

lines.en: : Because yeah, some of them might end up with actual parents in good families or something, but most of them don’t.
lines.zh: : 因为,没错,其中一些也许能碰上真正的好父母、好家庭什么的,但大多数不会。

lines.en: : If it comforts you, I don’t intend to ever reproduce.
lines.zh: : 如果这话能安慰你:我完全不打算繁衍。

lines.en: : Don’t need to intend anything. Accidents happen. What matters is what comes next.
lines.zh: : 不需要「打算」。意外总会有。重要的是接下来怎么办。

lines.en: : Say you did knock some girl up. Doesn’t have to be on purpose. Would you man-up and accept responsibility? Or would you get the fuck out of there because you’re not ready to be a dad?
lines.zh: : 假设你真的搞大了某个女孩的肚子。不一定是有意的。你会挺身而出、承担责任吗?还是趁早滚蛋,因为你还没准备好当爸爸?

lines.en: : Let’s change topics.
lines.zh: : 我们换个话题。

lines.en: : Hard choice, right? Neither one of them is what you want. And because of that, somebody is gonna suffer no matter what- whether it be you, the person carrying the baby, or the baby itself.
lines.zh: : 很难选,对吧?两个都不是你想要的。正因为如此,不管怎样,总有人要受苦——要么是你,要么是怀孩子的她,要么是孩子本身。

lines.en: : It’s easy enough to avoid that ultimatum if you’re careful. But as a woman who once boned a bassist for backstage passes, I understand that we’re not always our best selves.
lines.zh: : 只要小心,这种终极二选一是可以避开的。但作为一个曾经为了后台通行证睡过贝斯手的女人,我理解,我们并不总能保持最好的自己。

lines.en: : It’s tough to judge what’s right and wrong when you get caught up in the moment.
lines.zh: : 身在其中时,很难判断对错。

lines.en: : Just don’t run away from the consequences if things get all fucked up. You hear me? Cause if you disrespect your elders, I’ll hit you.
lines.zh: : 只要记住:事情一旦搞砸,别逃避后果。听到没?你要是不尊重长辈,我可要动手了。

lines.en: : And I’m clearly ripped. So you’d be done for, punk. Don’t mess with Rika.
lines.zh: : 而且我明显一身腱子肉。你死定了,小混混。别惹 Rika。

lines.en: : I think Rika should spend some more time at the gym before calling herself ripped. I would defeat you in your current state.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Rika 应该再多去几次健身房,再自称一身腱子肉。就你现在的状态,我能轻松放倒你。

lines.en: : Hey! Don’t be mean! If I was still in my prime, I could totally take you down!
lines.zh: : 喂!别这么刻薄!我要是还在巅峰期,绝对能放倒你!

lines.en: : If you were still in your prime, we’d probably be having sex in a tour bus.
lines.zh: : 你要还在巅峰期,我们现在多半会在巡演大巴上做爱。

lines.en: : Why? Do you play bass?
lines.zh: : 为什么?你弹贝斯?

lines.en: : I can learn.
lines.zh: : 我可以学。

lines.en: : I get why Rin likes you.
lines.zh: : 我明白 Rin 为什么喜欢你了。

lines.en: : Because...I make sexual passes at her mom?
lines.zh: : 因为……我对她妈妈进行过性骚扰?

lines.en: : Because you’re a goober. Like her.
lines.zh: : 因为你是个傻鹅。和她一样。

lines.en: : Did you just call me a “goober?”
lines.zh: : 你刚才是不是叫我「傻鹅」?

lines.en: : Yeah. Cause you are one.
lines.zh: : 对。因为你就是。

lines.en: : Rika, I don’t like that.
lines.zh: : Rika,我不喜欢这个称呼。

lines.en: : Tough cookies, goober. Be less of a goober and I won’t call you a goober anymore.
lines.zh: : 忍着吧,傻鹅。少犯点傻,我就不叫你傻鹅了。

lines.en: : I’m going home.
lines.zh: : 我要回家了。

lines.en: : Without an umbrella? That’s a real goober move, buddy. You sure you don’t wanna come back-
lines.zh: : 不带伞?真是一记标准的傻鹅操作,伙计。你确定不回来了——

lines.en: : Yes. Goodbye forever.
lines.zh: : 确定。永别了。

lines.en: : Heh...
: I hope not.
lines.zh: : 我希望不是。

lines.en: The night ends the same way it began.
lines.zh: : 这一夜怎么开始,就怎么结束。

lines.en: Wet.
lines.zh: : 湿的。

lines.en: I say this as someone who is decidedly ungooberish.
lines.zh: : 我说这话时,可以明确地讲,我绝不是傻鹅。

lines.en: Rika’s affection has increased to [rika_love]!
lines.zh: Rika 的好感度提升到了 [rika_love]!
